name: starfield_mystic_one_counter_for_my_enchantment_put_into_a_graveyard_from_the_battlefield
notes: Printed: 'Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Seat 0's Charm goes to the graveyard: one +1/+1 counter on the Mystic, which is 3/3. The opponent's Charm and seat 0's artifact going to the graveyard give nothing, so there is exactly one counter.
